content.title: The NT canon was not decided at Nicaea
content.author: Michael J. Kruger · Canon Fodder
content.note: For distinguishing the church's recognition of Scripture from a council creating its authority. Discusses the surviving evidence rather than attributing the canon to Nicaea.
